en: A black‑and‑white photograph showing a large crowd gathered beside a stationary passenger train. Most people wear early 20th‑century formal clothing: men in suits and hats, women in dresses and wide‑brimmed hats, some holding umbrellas or flowers. Two men in dark coats stand with their backs to the camera facing the crowd, suggesting a speech, greeting, or ceremonial reception on the platform. The train cars are wooden with vertical paneling and several open windows; there are trees in the background.
